citation.title: An overview of charge-exchange spectroscopy as a plasma diagnostic

topic: Review of charge-exchange spectroscopy: atomic physics, impurity densities, and impurity-ion temperature and rotation from Doppler width and shift.
own_question: How charge-exchange excitation lines can be interpreted, and with what corrections and pitfalls, to diagnose fusion plasmas.
actual_method_and_evidence: Narrative review. It compiles theoretical cross sections and state-mixing and excited-beam effects. It illustrates applications with published data from ATF, PDX, TFTR, TEXTOR, JET, CHS and JIPP TII-U. Text only was supplied, so no figures were visually checked. It contains no nowcasting, BES or ECEI fusion, or KSTAR content.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: CES infers impurity-ion temperature and rotation from Doppler width and shift of beam-induced charge-exchange lines, such as the C VI 5292 Å line, localized where the sightline crosses the neutral beam.
claim_checks.qualification: The measurement is of impurity (e.g. carbon) ions, not directly main ions. This is a 1994 review and does not describe KSTAR systems.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Reported CES temperatures depend on analysis choices. Cold edge components, fine-structure and Zeeman splitting, plume emission, and energy-dependent cross sections can bias fitted widths. This supports treating CES reports as conventional labels rather than independent truth.
claim_checks.qualification: The magnitudes of these effects are device- and condition-specific. The cited figures were not inspected.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Reports multichannel cadences for other devices: complete profiles every 16.6 ms on JIPP TII-U, and other systems faster than 1 ms. Says nothing about report arrival latency or KSTAR 2022.
validation_if_relevant: Not applicable. This is a review with no predictive validation.
forbidden_inferences: Do not use it to state KSTAR CES cadence, latency or uncertainty.
Do not claim it shows CES temperature is main-ion temperature.
Do not cite it for real-time or nowcasting capability.
Do not claim it establishes BES or ECEI relationships to ion temperature.
Do not generalize its timing numbers to all CES systems.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Include as a background reference for how carbon CES temperature is produced. It also supports the label-not-truth caveat through its discussion of line-shape systematics. Keep it as background only, not as evidence about our task.
